title: Does Liking Yellow Imply Driving a School Bus? Semantic Leakage in Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the undue influence of unrelated words in a prompt on the generated text by comparing the semantic similarity of test generations versus control generations to a specific concept using embedding methods (BERT-Score, SentenceBERT, OpenAI embeddings) and human evaluation, quantified by a metric called 'Leak-Rate'.
